controlled-language.reason: Requirements expressed as observable contracts: exit codes 0/2/3, per-command output strings, validation rules, empty-state strings.

domain/state.reason: Dateless model, not-done->done lifecycle, indefinite carryover, retained-hidden completed, store schema + load validation all settled.

goal/obstacle.reason: Goal (morning not-done view) and obstacles (carryover accumulation, mis-add cleanup via delete) analyzed; nag-accumulation logged as accepted consequence.

misuse.reason: Degenerate title inputs enumerated (empty/whitespace/oversized/control) at add and load; atomic save; corrupt-store handling.

quality.reason: Personal single-user local CLI; no architecture-significant quality attribute (perf/scale/availability) in play.

viewpoint.reason: Single personal local user; no other stakeholders, ops, billing, or compliance surface.
